properties.note: Henderson County's 13 voting precincts. The geometry is the Census 2020 voting-district fabric, which sums to the county's exact 2020 population of 6,387; the names are the county's own, taken from its certified returns and identical in the 2024 General (ISBE election 66) and the 2026 General Primary (ISBE election 69). Henderson County's board members are not carried: its own site is a parked domain and no election-results publisher carries its canvasses, so nothing reachable names them. No polling place is carried, and no roster.
properties.source: Census 2020 voting districts under Henderson County's own precinct names, as its certified returns spell them
